message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right size, and `npm test` passes all 20 tests.

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. `percent` is a 0–100 value, but the code multiplied the payment amount by it directly, so a 50% refund came out 50 times too large. It now divides by 100 before rounding. I changed only that file.
